query: New memory-management code breaks WAN 2.2 workflows on AMD ROCm: crash right after the first KSampler step (step 2 never starts) with 6GB VRAM laptop GPU; only WAN 2.2 graphs affected.

desired.outcome: OP-confirmed workaround: disable async offload and pinned memory, fall back to subquadratic cross-attention (launch flags --disable-async-offload --disable-pinned-memory --use-quad-cross-attention). Maintainer tracked the async-offload code path.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
